events.title: Founding of Lanternhold and Sealing of the Quiet Crown
events.summary: Three founders from Spark, Roots, and Stars seal the Quiet Crown inside the Heart-Vault behind the Threefold Keys and build Lanternhold Academy above the cliffs.

events.title: The Whispering Bell Cracks
events.summary: During a fierce winter gale near the Sunken Bells, the tower bell cracks and begins chiming silently in Star-casters' minds whenever Hollow Magic stirs.

events.title: Clara Crosses the Fog Arch
events.summary: Eleven-year-old Clara enters Glasshaven for First-Term Foundations alongside Leo, Maya, and Sam, with no prior bond to Master Jorge or Master Marissa.
